health_checks.requirements: two consecutive health checks plus one non-mutating smoke call per service

known_deviations: The bundled scripted and MuJoCo calibration engines are instrumentation-only and excluded from scientific outcomes.
Pilot-local alternate loopback ports were used because pre-existing forwards on 8000/8080/9000 were owned by unknown processes and unhealthy; those processes were not terminated.

The first formal service preflight failed under filesystem/network sandboxing and is retained as attempt 1; attempts 2 through 10 ran with authorized host access and passed. Attempts 8, 9, and 10 gated v6, v7, and v8 respectively.
Mechanism scene preflight attempt 1 retained one reachable IK local-minimum failure; the deterministic multi-start correction was tested and all 29 scenarios passed in attempt 2.

The production MuJoCo engine pilot exercises only the T5/NM02/primary-backbone base path. It does not enact a distinct locked split fixture, and the cell-capability gate therefore refuses every locked assignment.

Production pilot v4 is retained as INVALID_HARNESS: slow topology construction exposed a nonzero video-source origin and MuJoCo render-phase quantization fault before any model call. v5 froze the corrected t=0 slate, raw-cadence, CFR-quantization, and harness-fault-classification contracts.

Production pilot v5 is retained as INVALID_HARNESS after two successful model calls: a nested Planner capture replaced the global HRI capture identity, so the post-tool HRI request was rejected before oracle evaluation. v6 freezes request-scoped immutable capture resolution plus independent successful-call-to-frame audit cross-checks.

Production pilot v6 is retained as INVALID_HARNESS after 17 model calls and before oracle evaluation: demand-driven evidence acquisition produced two source-starvation gaps longer than 30 seconds, and the accepted raw-camera jitter window could quantize two captures to the same CFR slot. The proposed v7 pilot source adds an attempt-owned acquisition pump, pre-write same-slot filtering, realtime-loop rebasing after stalls, and acquisition-identity freshness auditing.

Production pilot v7 is retained as INVALID_HARNESS after five completed model calls and before oracle evaluation: the evidence coordinator filtered duplicate CFR slots but did not mirror the writer's independent raw-camera cadence gate, so an over-rate acquisition in a later slot terminated recording. The proposed v8 source consumes both same-slot and over-rate producer frames before video or request linkage while preserving raw timestamps and the unchanged writer backstop.

Production pilot v8 is retained as INVALID_HARNESS after 19 model calls: controller COMPLETE, the physical predicate, and both scenario oracles evaluated PASS, but independent video audit rejected a 56.6-second stale-source interval above the frozen 30.0-second limit. Those fields are diagnostic only and excluded from outcomes. No v9 or threshold relaxation is authorized until the MuJoCo producer/recorder lifecycle is redesigned and validated attempt-long.

Upper and embedding model-call artifacts preserve redacted application-level semantic requests and parsed responses, not exact raw HTTP request/response bodies; this pilot cannot close that Gate 1 artifact-contract blocker.

The current post-v7 source uses atomic task/overview evidence-frame pairs, MuJoCo-time gravity-relative controller pacing, a serialized evidence pump, and identical pre-write/writer camera-rate thresholds. The experiment suite passed 190/190, the focused physical MuJoCo simulation suite passed 10/10, and a real-MuJoCo blocked-consumer liveness regression measured fresh acquisitions without a source-age violation; the host sustained about 4.1 fresh atomic pairs per second rather than native 10 Hz.
